market_summary: Democrats won both chambers in the midterms and US stocks rallied: Dow up about 2.9%, Nasdaq up 1.9% intraday. Treasury yields slipped a few bps, the 10-year near 4.9%, and oil fell more than 8% on expectations of pressure to end the Iran war; no confirmed progress in Iran talks was found. AI leaders lagged (NVDA, MU, TSM about -1%) while mega-cap platforms led, though AMD's Q3 beat (+7% after hours) supports AI capex demand. ADP showed 86,000 private jobs in October; ISM services and ARM/QCOM results were not yet confirmed at time of writing. No material China news found.

headlines: Democrats take both chambers; Dow up about 2.9% intraday, oil down 8%, 10-yr near 4.9%.
Mega-caps lead: AMZN +7%, GOOGL +5%, META +2%; NVDA -1% as AI hardware lags.
Texas governor result pledges a data-centre pause; VRT -14%, GEV -10%, BE -8% intraday.
AMD beats in Q3, up 7% after hours; added to watchlist. CRDO dropped.
